messages.subject: Workshop Agenda
parts:
Hi Everybody,

As of now we thought of conducting one day workshop on R which consist
of following modules.
The modules are the result of today's discussion but is subjected to
change as per the response of the people.

1. Introduction & interaction among the members.

2. Basic Module
The following topics will be covered in this module:
(a) Why R ?
(b) Familiarizing the users with R, trying to bring the
awareness
(c) Tour through R
(d) Using R
(e) Using R statistical functions by taking real problem
(g) Using R graphics
(h) Debugging, Exceptional handling , profiling in R

3. Application Module:
This module will present the real use case of R from various
domains:
(a) Banking and Finance domain
(b) Stock Market
(c) Using R on distributed environment like Hadoop
(d) Interfacing R with High level languages like C++, Java.
-------------We have not yet decided upon the problems.

I know it is not sufficient and it requires more brain storming. Well
i would like the group to drive this program and make this a real
success.

[ Don't worry we have planned some interesting activity in between to
keep us awake :-) and alive through out the workshop

Please suggest and keep us posted what else you want?

Regards,
Som Shekhar
